title: PROGRAM CHANGE -> SOUND
author: irpina
description: A synth track takes a pool sound from a program change on its MIDI channel (MIDI CONFIG > CHANNELS), or from PRG on TRIG's second page (press TRIG twice): program 1 is pool sound 001, 128 is 128. PRG is per pattern and p-locks per trig (hold the trig and turn): a locked trig plays that sound at once and the track keeps it; a pattern's own PRG loads when the pattern comes up, as an Elektron MIDI track's PROG. A program change it uses is the mod's: the stock does not also change the pattern for it. For the Digitone mk1 and Digitone Keys, OS 1.43 and 1.44 (it names no firmware address: its 1.44 port is empty). Needs core-dn1 5.1.
